stories.title: Sources: Rams signing free agent kicker Brandon McManus
stories.summary: The Rams, after releasing Harrison Mevis and an injury to Blake Grupe, are signing free agent kicker Brandon McManus, sources told NFL Network.
stories.detail: LOS ANGELES -- The Rams are signing kicker Brandon McManus , sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo on Tuesday. The Rams worked out McManus and free agent kicker Matt Prater on Tuesday after kicker Blake Grupe tore his ACL in a Week 6 loss to the Arizona Cardinals . Grupe was playing in his first game for the Rams after he was signed to replace Harrison Mevis , who missed a 50-yard field goal attempt and then had a 48-yarder blocked in overtime of the Rams' Week 5 loss. McManus last kicked for the Green Bay Packers after signing with them in 2024. He was 44 of 51 for Green Bay over two seasons, with six misses coming during the 2025 season. He spent his first nine seasons with the Denver Broncos and one with the Jacksonville Jaguars and was not on a roster to start the 2024 season while being investigated by the NFL for possible violations of the personal conduct policy. In September 2024, the NFL announced McManus was not in violation of the policy and he signed with the Packers three weeks later.

stories.title: Rams turn to third kicker in three weeks after Blake Grupe's injury
stories.summary: The Rams are turning to their third kicker in as many weeks with Brandon McManus, who takes over after Blake Grupe suffered a torn ACL.
stories.detail: The Los Angeles Rams are taking another shot at solving their kicking woes after their fallback plan went awry. The team signed veteran Brandon McManus on Tuesday, Sept. 20. McManus and fellow veteran Matt Prater worked out for the team earlier in the day. The move comes just one day after Rams coach Sean McVay announced that Blake Grupe suffered a torn anterior cruciate ligament while trying to make a tackle in the first quarter of an 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday. Grupe had replaced kicker Harrison Mevis, who added to the team's growing special teams woes when he missed a 50-yard field goal attempt and had a 48-yard kick blocked in overtime of a 37-34 loss to the Buffalo Bills in a Week 5 "Monday Night Football" tilt. The Rams cut Mevis, who made just five of nine field-goal attempts on the season, one day later. McManus, 35, spent the last two years with the Green Bay Packers. His three missed kicks - including an extra-point attempt and field-goal try in the fourth quarter - would loom large in a 31-27 loss to the Chicago Bears in the wild-card round of the NFC playoffs. Despite signing him to a three-year, $15.3 million contract the previous March, Green Bay r…

stories.title: Rams add K Brandon McManus
stories.summary: The Rams have found a new kicker.
stories.detail: The Rams have found a new kicker. According to multiple reports, veteran Brandon McManus has agreed to join Los Angeles. McManus, 35, was most recently with the Packers last season. He made 24-of-30 field goals and 32-of-33 extra points in 14 regular season games. But in the playoff loss to Chicago, he missed two field goals and an extra point, leading the Packers to move on in the offseason. McManus is a Super Bowl champion, having won it with Denver to cap the 2015 season. He made all 10 field goals and all three extra points in that postseason run. In 186 career regular-season games, McManus has made 82.0 percent of his field goals and 97.4 percent of his extra points. Los Angeles placed kicker Blake Grupe on injured reserve on Monday after he suffered a torn ACL during Sunday’s game against the Cardinals. The club had released Harrison Mevis last week after a rough start to the season. The Rams will be on the road to face the Raiders in Week 7.

stories.detail: The Charlotte Hornets will be without guards Kon Knueppel and Coby White as well as veteran forward Grant Williams as they open their season Wednesday at the Brooklyn Nets . Knueppel, who was the first rookie to lead the league with 273 made 3-pointers last season, injured his left hamstring during offseason on-court activity and missed the entire preseason. White suffered a left calf strain Oct. 5 during training camp and missed the remainder of preseason. Williams was ruled out for all four of Charlotte's preseason games because of a right hamstring injury. The team said Tuesday that all three players have resumed individual on-court activity. The Hornets are hoping to rely on Knueppel and White this season after trading LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves over the summer. Knueppel averaged 18.5 points, 5.3 rebounds and 42.5% 3-point shooting as a rookie. The Hornets acquired White from the Chicago Bulls in February, and he went on to have a strong finish to the season with his new team. He was the hero in the team's play-in victory over the Miami Heat , scoring 19 points and hitting the turnaround 3 late in regulation to force overtime. He signed a three-year, $74 million…

stories.title: Paul George points today: New star has record debut for Celtics vs. Pistons
stories.summary: Paul George set a new Boston Celtics record for points in a debut. And he did it before the third quarter ended.
stories.detail: Paul George had a record-breaking performance for the Boston Celtics before the third quarter was even over in Tuesday's season opener . Brought to Boston as part of the Jaylen Brown trade, George had 31 points in his first 20 minutes of action. He was 10-for-14 from the floor and 6 of 8 from 3-point range. Those 31 points are already a new franchise record for a Celtics debut. The 36-year-old has played well off of Jayson Tatum, suggesting this partnership could keep the Celtics among the Eastern Conference's elite if George can stay healthy. That's a big if considering his recent track record, but George's debut for Boston has been a treat. Paul George stats today Stats through three quarters. stories.detail: The AJ Dybantsa Rookie of the Year train will not leave the station on time Wednesday. Dybantsa will miss the Wizards' opener against the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday with a tweaked ankle, coach Brian Keefe told reporters . He added that Dybantsa is day-to-day going forward. The Wizards have a back-to-back over the weekend, hosting Toronto on Friday then traveling to Chicago on Saturday. The Wizards selected Dybantsa with the No. 1 overall pick, and hopes are high that he can be a catalyst to help turn a long-struggling franchise around. After an impressive Summer League, Dybantsa was still finding his footing in the preseason, averaging 12.8 points per game on 43.9% shooting, and just 18.2% from 3-point range. Dybantsa is paired with All-Stars Trae Young and Anthony Davis to start his rookie season, and there is debate around the league about whether or not this is good for his development. Scouts were divided about the idea, as they detailed to Josh Robbins in a fantastic story at The Athletic . Some scouts said it would be a "massive positive" not to have Dybantsa carry so much of the load and that he can figure out the game without having to create a ton of offense. Another sc…
